_schema: UserSchema — Defines the structure for self-registered platform users. These are NOT system admins. They register via the public registration wizard, create their own tenant, and access subscribed modules.

fields.email: string — User email (unique, used for login)
fields.passwordHash: string — bcrypt hash (NEVER store plain text)
fields.tenantId: string — The tenant this user owns/belongs to

indexes.email_unique: email — Must be unique across all users
indexes.tenantId: tenantId — For querying users by tenant
